text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for streaming endpoints in eu-west-1. SLO breach threshold crossed (p99 > 2.5s). Auto-paging oncall. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/streams-eu-west1

anna_oncall: I got the page, looking now. seeing a big tail at ~10:12 UTC. do we have customer-facing errors?

support_lead: quick check: a handful of customers reporting streaming stalls and dropped chunks, no bulk 5xx but long stalls causing timeouts in client. ticket queue: 7 customers, 3 high-usage accounts flagged.

tilly_sre: jumping in. Graphs show sudden P99 jump coincident with a routing-policy rollout at 10:10 by raj_engineering. possible weight drift -> traffic funneled into a small set of ingress pods.

raj_engineering: I pushed a config change to ingress-routing yesterday late (weight-based redistribution). I rolled canary at 10:08 and promoted at 10:09 according to CI. rolling back now.

mike_runtime: tagging runtime-team. suspecting KV cache hotset + routing concentrating requests on a few routers. streaming stalls would match persistent hot connections starving other queues.

anna_oncall: mitigation plan: (1) rollback routing promotion (raj) (2) temporarily enable cross-zone balancing in eu-west-1 (infra) (3) divert streaming to cold-standby pool for affected tenants (tilly)

raj_engineering: rollback command queued: ``kubectl apply -f /deploys/ingress/weights/weights-v2-previous.yaml``. running now.

deploy-bot: deploy started by raj_engineering at 10:18 UTC: /deploys/ingress/weights/weights-v2-previous.yaml

mike_runtime: while rollback runs, add a short-term throttle on highest-concurrency routes to reduce queue buildup. runbook suggests: ``/ops/throttle set --route streaming.* --concurrency 40 --duration 15m``

tilly_sre: running diversion for flagged customers: routing rule set to route tenant IDs [acct-23, acct-99, acct-77] to standby-pool. Command: ``routerctl route set --tenants acct-23,acct-99,acct-77 --pool standby-pool-eu``

infra-bot: cross-zone balancing toggle executed by anna_oncall at 10:22 UTC. New balancing policy: round_robin_with_imbalance_limit=0.15

support_lead: customers updated on progress. no escalations to legal/enterprise yet.

anna_oncall: rollback finished at 10:26. early signs: p95 down slightly but p99 still elevated. looks like weight rollback partial; some routers still have hot KV caches.

tilly_sre: evidence in logs: repeated affinity binds to two router instances (router-32, router-33) for many distinct sessions. suspecting hash partitioning bug in the new policy that maps session keys -> narrow set.

raj_engineering: oh — I forgot to include the fallback shards mapping in the canary. That would cause affinity to fall back to a degenerate mapping. opening PR to revert rule changes and add test.

mike_runtime: new idea: force-refresh KV cache on hot routers via an admin endpoint to break cache hotness. Command: ``curl -XPOST https://router-32.admin.internal/_refresh_cache`` (careful, this is disruptive).

tilly_sre: doing cache refreshs one at a time with 30s delay to avoid thundering herd. refreshing router-32 now.

anna_oncall: p99 dropped from 6.2s -> 3.1s after router-32 refresh. still above SLO. proceeding to refresh router-33.

mike_runtime: agree on staggered refresh. also recommend temporarily increasing dynamic worker threads on standby-pool to absorb diverted streams: ``ctl pool scale standby-pool-eu --workers +10``

raj_engineering: PR created: revert ingress weight mapping and add test coverage for fallback mapping. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1247

tilly_sre: refreshed router-33. p99 now ~1.8s. p95 stable at 200-300ms. streaming stalls rate dropped ~85%. good signal.

support_lead: notified impacted customers of mitigation and ETA for full resolution. they want root cause and timeline for rollback permanently.

lee_product: logging note: on customers using low-latency streaming tiers (paid) we saw 3 intermittent reconnects. need billing/credits decision?

anna_oncall: instantiate incident channel, set severity: Sev2 for now (customer impact but partial mitigation). create incident doc. I will hand off to tilly for post-mortem and raj for remediation.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-4558. incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-4558

tilly_sre: collecting logs for timeline. queries: ``logs query "router-32 OR router-33" | where latency>5000``. saving snapshot to incident doc.

raj_engineering: merging revert now. will schedule a safe promotion only after adding unit/integration tests.

mike_runtime: post-mitigation action items: - add canary gating for affinity mapping - add synthetic streaming load to canary - add KV-cache hotkey detector to runtime metrics.

anna_oncall: handoff: I'm off-shift in 20m. tilly_sre, take lead on post-incident triage and coordinate with raj for code fix. mike_runtime, please own runtime follow-ups.

tilly_sre: taking lead. creating follow-up ticket for detailed RCA and customer impact table.

support_lead: preparing customer summary and compensation recommendations. will sync with legal if needed.

mike_runtime: logging final mitigation state: weight rollback complete, cross-zone balancing on, targeted tenant diversion active, router caches refreshed. monitoring for 1h before closing incident.

anna_oncall: acknowledgement: thanks everyone. closing pager to oncall after handoff.

deploy-bot: Pager closed by anna_oncall at 11:35 UTC.

tilly_sre: last check at 11:40 UTC: p99 holding ~1.6s, within SLO safety margin after mitigation. moving to RCA and follow-ups.

anna_oncall: quick notes for RCA: root cause = routing-policy promotion missing fallback shard mapping -> degenerate affinity -> hot partitioning of routers -> KV cache starvation -> streaming stalls. contributing factors: insufficient canary gating and lack of KV-hotkey detection.

raj_engineering: action items I own: revert verified, add automated test for fallback mapping, add canary synthetic streaming job. ETA: 3 days for tests + 1 day for canary rollout.

tilly_sre: SRE action items: add KV hotkey alert (p95/p99 delta per router), add automated staggered cache-refresh runbook, document diversion play. ETA: 2 days.

support_lead: will finalize customer communication template and list of affected accounts in incident doc.

mike_runtime: will prototype hotkey detector and add an OOM/latency guard to router admin endpoints.

tilly_sre: assigning RCA authoring to raj + tilly. target postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow.

support_lead: closing notes: no single customer reported data loss. impact: degraded streaming quality and reconnects for a subset of paid customers for ~25 minutes. recommending 10% credit for affected tenants; will propose in postmortem.

deploy-bot: thread archived to incident INC-2026-4558 at 11:45 UTC.
